what: white matter with cortex on both sides, in faint noise, and an area for every voxel: the cortex takes the areas' labels and nothing else does. A box cut from a larger grid, stored as coronal slices: outside the box every label is 0

chances.holds: little-endian f32; the chance of each structure at each voxel of the padded grid, as a network's [x, y, z, structure] with the structure fastest: values[((x * padded_y + y) * padded_z + z) * structures + structure]

areas.holds: one byte a voxel of the padded grid: the cortex area there as Volsa's cortex network gives it, 1 plus the place of the largest of the chances of areas 1 to 68; [x, y, z] with z fastest: values[(x * padded_y + y) * padded_z + z]

labels.holds: little-endian i32; SynthSeg's label at each voxel of the grid as stored: columns fastest, then rows, then slices: values[(slice * rows + row) * cols + col]
